**41,400,000**

Note that the dominant Southern giraffe species has larger, fewer spots, while others have more, keeping the average in this range.

    *   $120,000 \text{ giraffes} \times 345 \text{ spots/giraffe} = 41,400,000 \text{ total spots}$.
